plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: One Claude Code plugin for the whole software lifecycle: an orchestrator sizes each piece of work (S/M/L) and walks it through four gated phases (define, build, prove, ship), from spec and design through test-first builds that prove each acceptance criterion with one verify command, a Prove round of an acceptance checker, review and (only where security is touched) security checks on the bigger tracks, to ship and learn, plus guardrail hooks, design-system-aware UI review and setup/upgrade for any stack or monorepo.
